Text summarisation compresses long textual documents into short summaries while retaining the most important information from the source.

We propose a new evaluation metric based on content weighting, where we abstract away from the particular surface form of the target summary, but represent it as facts using Semantic Role Labelling (SRL).

We introduce two metrics: Corr-F (fact-level) and Corr-A (argument-level). ... We compare our metrics against existing reference‑based ROUGE and BERTScore, as well as the referenceless manual HROUGE score.
